title: Delete or reactivate the dead tautological placeholders in v15_to_v16_test.dart's skipped group
why: Both assertions are dead literals left after the derived_from_events column was removed: line 68-72 is `expect(true, isFalse, ...)` which will FAIL immediately the instant the group's `skip:` is lifted, and line 111-116 is `expect(true, isTrue, ...)` which passes forever and tests nothing. This repo's own root CLAUDE.md documents the reactivation workflow as "remove the skip: parameter... replace the empty () {} bodies with real assertions" — implying skipped tests should carry empty bodies, exactly the clean pattern used two files over in v18_to_v19_test.dart in this same batch. Worse, two of the four tests in this same skipped group (duplicate-commit dedup, migration-backfill row survival) contain real, still-valid assertions unrelated to the removed field and could be unskipped today, but sit dark under one blanket skip.
recommendation: Delete the two placeholder tests (or rewrite them against whatever invariant superseded derived_from_events), and split the two tests with real assertions out of the skipped group so they run in CI now.
acceptance_criteria: grep for `expect(true, isFalse` / `expect(true, isTrue` with a `// placeholder` marker in test/ returns zero hits
the duplicate-commit and migration-backfill tests in this file run unskipped in CI
